name: Detonation: carbon–oxygen (network)
blurb: A detonation in white dwarf matter, burned by a trained neural network of the 13-isotope alpha chain (aprox13): carbon and oxygen at rest in a 1000 km tube, set alight by a hot layer at its closed end. The shocked fuel burns behind the front through oxygen and silicon toward the iron group; how far it gets depends on the density.

featured.label: Density (log₁₀ g/cm³)
featured.tip: Density of the fuel, log10 of g/cm^3: white dwarf matter is 6 to 9.5. Above about 1e8 the ash reaches the iron group; below 1e7 burning stops at silicon or oxygen. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Carbon fraction
featured.tip: Mass fraction of carbon in the fuel, the rest oxygen. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Fuel temperature (10⁸ K)
featured.tip: Temperature of the unburned fuel, in 1e8 K. Gas below 1e8 K does not burn. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Ignition temperature (10⁹ K)
featured.tip: Temperature of the layer at the closed end that sets the fuel alight, in 1e9 K. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Ignition layer (km)
featured.tip: Thickness of the hot layer at the closed end, in km. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Burn inside shocks
featured.tip: Let cells the shock detector flags burn (1) or not (0). Off, as in most supernova codes: a captured shock is a few cells of numerical smearing, and burning there lets the scheme set the front. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Burning limiter f
featured.tip: No cell takes in burning energy faster than f times its internal energy per sound crossing of the cell (Kushnir et al. 2013): on a grid far coarser than the burning, faster heating is numerically unstable and lights detonations too early. Kushnir and coworkers use 0.05 to 0.1. With it, a detonation has to be lit over a region about dx/f across (Kushnir, Wygoda & Sharon 2020): the default 4e9 K layer then drives only a shock that does not ignite, while an 8e9 K layer lights a detonation that runs at the unlimited speed. It applies only where dx/f is much smaller than every other scale of the problem (Kushnir & Katz 2020). 0 switches it off (the default). Changing it starts the run again
